title: Proof Pathway — Sprintboard & Communication Tapestry
body:
Purpose:
This is a working sprintboard + comms plan for the Proof Pathway POC with AcmeAnalytics. Goal: run a 6-week POC that demonstrates 3x improvement in per-request latency and 40% lower per-token cost vs their current hosted provider while keeping response quality >= baseline (black-box eval set).

Scope (what's in/out):
- In: model serving integration (hosted -> dedicated), latency tuning (batching/config), KV cache for session state, quantization profiling, end-to-end load tests, basic security checklist for demo (TLS, API key rotation).
- Out: full private deployment package, long-term SLA negotiation, custom feature engineering for customer-domain prompts (will be a follow-up).

Success criteria (must be measurable):
- Latency: median 95th token latency <= 120ms under demo workload (10 concurrent sessions).
- Cost: projected per-token unit cost improvement >= 35% against customer baseline.
- Quality: BLEU-like pass rate on nightly eval >= 92% compared to baseline; no more than 6% drop in human-evaluated fidelity on key prompt set.
- Stability: zero P0 outages during demo window (2-week window after week 6).

High-level timeline (milestone dates):
- Week -1 (2025-09-15): Kickoff + environment access (customer provides sample traffic + eval prompts)
- Week 1 (2025-09-22): Baseline profiling, ingestion pipeline, initial serving config (first benchmark)
- Week 2 (2025-09-29): KV caching experiment + small-batch tuning; workshop #1 with customer (design decisions)
- Week 3 (2025-10-06): Quantization and model variant run; deploy dedicated nodepool for load testing
- Week 4 (2025-10-13): Load test & performance tuning; start nightly eval harness
- Week 5 (2025-10-20): Demo prep, run final regressions, canary rollout to customer sandbox
- Week 6 (2025-10-27): Customer demo + collect feedback; handoff notes + next steps proposal

Sprintboard & Task Tracker (kanban-lite; status = todo / in-progress / blocked / done):
- PROF-01 | Baseline ingestion & sample dataset ingestion | owner: Priya | status: done | notes: got 120k sample tokens, missing edge-case prompts (ask customer)
- PROF-02 | Latency profiler + op-level traces (get p95s) | owner: Marco | status: in-progress | notes: tracer added to staging; some traces truncated (ENG-2345)
- SERV-10 | Dedicated nodepool provisioning | owner: Elliot | status: todo | notes: request quota increase (cloud ticket OPEN-901)
- SERV-11 | KV cache integration spike | owner: Sana | status: in-progress | notes: initial microbenchmark shows 18% token savings in prefix-heavy sessions
- OPT-04 | Quantization profile sweep (int8 / fp16) | owner: Ben | status: todo | notes: need to coordinate with Research for expected accuracy delta
- QA-20 | Nightly eval harness + human eval queue | owner: Priya | status: todo | notes: annotate 250 prompts for human evaluation (use CS temp lab)
- COMM-01 | Demo script + runbook | owner: Marco | status: todo | notes: two demo scenarios (happy path / degraded fallback)

Risk Register (id | risk | impact | mitigation | owner | status):
- R1 | Customer cannot share traffic pattern due to policy | HIGH | Ask for sanitized sampling + synthetic replay; fallback: use Redwood-generated synthetic that mirrors distribution | Priya | mitigated (in-progress)
- R2 | Nodepool quota delays slow down provisioning | MED | Pre-request increases, use hosted fallback for demo if necessary | Elliot | open
- R3 | Quantization causes unacceptable quality regression | HIGH | Hold canary on small subset, roll back plan, tune quantization parameters, add eval gating | Ben | monitoring
- R4 | Unexpected auth/integration mismatch with customer SSO | MED | Pre-demo integration checklist, dedicated SE time in week 2 for auth debugging | Sana | open

Workshop #1 (agenda - week 2):
- 30m: Kickoff & objectives alignment (customer exec + engineering)
- 60m: Deep dive on customer traffic / data shape (we bring profiler outputs)
- 45m: Design decisions: caching strategy, latency SLOs, rollback policy
- 30m: Acceptance criteria & demo scenarios (agree on eval prompts)
- 15m: Next-steps & owner commit list

Communication tapestry (who hears what when):
- Weekly sync (30m) — SE working group + customer eng lead; cadence: Mondays 10am PT; agenda: blockers, metrics, decisions.
- Mid-week async update — one-paragraph status in #solutions-poc (Slack) with link to latest perf dashboard. Owner: Elliot.
- Executive demo invite — 1-week notice before Week 6 demo; recipients: customer exec sponsor, Redwood AE, Solutions lead.
- Incident contact path — primary: Sana, secondary: Marco; use PagerDuty for any P0 during demo window.

Decision log (skeleton; capture during run):
- D1 | Decide model variant for demo (candidate: redwood-llama-13b-optimized) | tentative: week 3
- D2 | Batching target per-route (20ms/25ms) | TBD during week 2 microbenchmarks

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self and customer):
- Ask customer for exact token pricing they want to compare against (line-item).
- Confirm whether customer wants full TLS client certs for demo or just API keys.
- Validate SANITIZED data policy with their security contact (SLA impact).
- Add spike: streaming fallbacks when KV cache misses — performance implications.

Operational checklists (quick):
- Pre-demo: smoke test on canary, run 3 full end-to-end calls, check logs for errors, verify audit trails.
- Post-demo: share metrics + raw eval artifacts to customer S3, propose 30-day pilot pricing.

Notes / friction points observed so far:
- Customer sampling missing long-tail prompts; likely to affect quantization tuning.
- Some trace correlation IDs missing — need to instrument earlier in pipeline (ENG-2345 ticket).

Next immediate actions (this week):
- Elliot: file cloud quota increase, start nodepool request (ticket OPEN-901).
- Priya: finalize eval prompt set and get sign-off from customer security on sanitized samples.
- Marco: draft demo script and runbook; include fallback script for hosted-to-dedicated toggle.
- Ben: schedule quantization sweep and line up ROC curve comparisons with Research.

Appendix (links & quick refs):
- quick perf dashboard (staging): https://dash.redwood.ai/staging/poc/pp-001
- key tickets: POC-4821, ENG-2345, OPEN-901
- contact roster: Priya Shah (priya@redwood.ai), Marco Li (marco@redwood.ai), Sana Ahmed (sana@redwood.ai), Ben Carter (ben@redwood.ai)

-- end working doc --

Status: draft — this will be converted into a more formal runbook after week 2 workshop.
